answer: Because the timing is recorded against the tundra challenge, the sable audit can replay the grove history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 54 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4419 identities would post 3824 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
